persons.name: Viśvanātha
persons.evidence: viśvanāthapādhye (!) ghiṃmiryāḥ (!) caṇḍiko postakaḥ (!) śuddho vā aśuddho vā mama doṣo na diyate (!)

date.as_written: samvat 1956 sālamiti āśvinavadi 13 roja 2 nakṣatre pūraphlālguṇiḥ (!)

notes: The Nepali phrase 'caṇḍiko postakaḥ' ('the Caṇḍī book of [Viśvanātha]') combined with the traditional scribal disclaimer 'mama doṣo na dīyate' indicates that Viśvanātha Ghimire was the scribe and likely the owner.
